name: Omnitrix
description: A watch-like alien device discovered by Ben Tennyson. Cartoon Network’s official material states that it allows Ben to transform into a range of alien heroes.
origin: An alien device discovered by Ben Tennyson. The source used here establishes its transformation function, not its full creation history.
functions: Allows its wearer to transform into stored alien forms.
limitations: The exact limitations vary across the different Ben 10 series and are not consolidated in this entry.
specialFeatures: Enables temporary transformation into alien heroes
